user.title: Connect to the Sorégies customer portal
user.description:
Open {portal}, request a sign-in link, then paste the full address you receive by email here (or just the `access_token` it contains).

Your password is never requested nor stored. The link stays valid for ten days; Home Assistant will ask for a fresh one afterwards.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Sorégies access
reauth_confirm.description: The previous sign-in link has expired. Request a new one at {portal} and paste it here. Data already imported is kept.

error.invalid_token: No recognisable token in this text. Paste the full address of the link you received by email.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected this token; it has most likely expired. Request a new sign-in link.
error.wrong_account: This link belongs to a different delivery point. Use a link for the contract already configured.
error.cannot_connect: The Sorégies portal is unreachable right now.

abort.reauth_failed: The entry to renew could not be found.

init.title: Sorégies settings
init.description: History is imported as `soregies:` statistics. They are not wired into the Energy dashboard automatically, so they cannot add up on top of a meter you already declared.

data_description.history_months: Number of months read back during a full import. The portal never returns data from before the contract started.
data_description.cost_with_vat: Turn this off for amounts excluding tax.

import_history.name: Re-import history
import_history.description: Reads daily consumption month by month and rewrites the matching statistics. No risk of duplicates: existing points are replaced.

entry_id.name: Contract
entry_id.description: Identifier of the entry to re-import. All entries when left empty.

months.name: Depth
months.description: Number of months to read back. Defaults to the configured value.

token_expiring.title: The Sorégies sign-in link expires soon

confirm.title: Renew Sorégies access
confirm.description:
Access to the customer portal expires in {days} day(s), on {expiry}. Without renewal, history will stop updating.

Sign in at soregies.fr, open “Suivi de consommation”, copy the full page address, then confirm here: Home Assistant will ask you to paste it.
